verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It establishes the base case n=1, performs determinant-preserving column operations in descending order, expands along the first row, factors the resulting row factors, applies the induction hypothesis to the remaining Vandermonde determinant, and correctly combines the two products to obtain all factors indexed by 1 <= i < j <= n. The statement is self-contained, no prohibited proof patterns occur, and there are no references requiring validation.
